headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 30, 2026**
article:
The Miami Marlins secured a thrilling 8-6 victory over the Philadelphia Phillies, with Griffin Conine leading the offense with a home run and 2 RBIs. In other action, the Arizona Diamondbacks shut out the Pittsburgh Pirates 3-0 behind Eduardo Rodriguez's 8.0 innings of scoreless baseball. The Toronto Blue Jays took down the Washington Nationals 5-2, led by Kazuma Okamoto's 3 hits and 2 RBIs.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Jakob Junis, who was placed on the 15-day injured list by the Texas Rangers with a left adductor strain. The Rangers also transferred Jose Corniell to the 60-day injured list and Danny Jansen to the 60-day injured list. Other teams with injured players include the Minnesota Twins (Byron Buxton), Tampa Bay Rays (Cole Sulser), Kansas City Royals (Vinnie Pasquantino), and San Francisco Giants (Casey Schmitt).

The Detroit Tigers traded catcher Jake Rogers to the Baltimore Orioles for right-hander Zane Barnhart. The Los Angeles Angels traded catcher Logan O'Hoppe and right-hander Chase Silseth to the Texas Rangers for shortstop Angel Arredondo. The Baltimore Orioles also traded right fielder Johnathan Rodríguez to the Pittsburgh Pirates for cash.

top_news.title: **Marlins Take Down Phillies in Thrilling 8-6 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins secured a hard-fought win against the Philadelphia Phillies, with a final score of 8-6. Griffin Conine led the Marlins' offense with a home run and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Diamondbacks Shut Out Pirates 3-0**
top_news.summary: The Arizona Diamondbacks secured a shutout victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Eduardo Rodriguez pitching 8.0 innings of scoreless baseball. Rodriguez earned the win, while Brandyn Garcia secured the save.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Take Down Nationals 5-2**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays secured a 5-2 victory over the Washington Nationals, with Kazuma Okamoto leading the offense with 3 hits and 2 RBIs. Trey Yesavage earned the win with 6.2 innings pitched, striking out 4 and allowing 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Orioles Edge Tigers in Thrilling 10-9 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Baltimore Orioles secured a hard-fought 10-9 win over the Detroit Tigers, overcoming a late deficit to claim the victory. Spencer Torkelson led the Tigers' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Rays Edge Rangers in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays secured a 3-2 victory over the Texas Rangers, snapping a close contest in the final innings. Yandy Díaz and Cedric Mullins were key contributors for the winning team, while Jonny DeLuca had a notable performance for the Rangers.

top_news.title: **Royals Fall Short in Minnesota**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins edged out the Kansas City Royals 4-3 in a close matchup. Noah Cameron and other impact players on both teams, including John Rave and Jac Caglianone, played key roles in the game.

top_news.title: **Rangers' Junis Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Jakob Junis, a right-handed pitcher for the Texas Rangers, has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a left adductor strain. The move is retroactive to July 29, 2026.

top_news.title: **Tigers Acquire RHP Zane Barnhart in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers have made a move to bolster their pitching staff, acquiring right-handed pitcher Zane Barnhart from the Baltimore Orioles in exchange for catcher Jake Rogers.
